newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany express forwarder co-operates with Eurowings.
newsitem.headline: Germany express forwarder co-operates with Eurowings.

text.p: German express operator EASY (Express Air Systems GmbH) said it has started freight co-operation with Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG.
Eurowings has transported national and international shipments for EASY since the start of the summer schedule, a company statement said.
EASY managing director Nils Bohnes said the Eurowings network, in particular from Dortmund, allowed the company to improve its same-day service through short flight times and high frequencies.

The airline was an ideal addition to the network of Lufthansa Cargo which is one of the three EASY shareholders along with Schenker International AG and Kuehne & Nagel AG KNIZn.S, he added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax+5017
